text: The initiative is tailored to Small Island Developing States (SIDS) with a focus on rigorous technical flood diagnostics and resource mobilization. It emphasizes gender diversity and inclusion in expert selection and encourages national expert participation. The engagement is aligned with Fiji's national and regional disaster risk finance agendas, aiming to produce an actionable financing roadmap.

metadata.solution_name: DRRS Fiji: Disaster Risk Finance Specialist Engagement
